name: Kona
lede: A week on the dry side of the Big Island. Mantas under the boat lights on Tuesday, Jabari’s first dive on Wednesday, and Mauna Kea on Thursday, in a new-moon week, with dinner at 9,000 ft and a telescope after dark. The rest of the week is ours to fill, or not.
blurb: Seven nights on the Kona coast. Mantas at night, Jabari’s first dive, and sunset at the summit of Mauna Kea before a telescope under a new moon.
description: A week in Kona in December 2026. The manta night dive, a first scuba dive, and Mauna Kea under a new moon with a telescope. The days and the order.
